bullets.text: LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo World Congress in Barcelona to bring physical artificial intelligence into airports, hospitals, and stores.
Our office should monitor the deployment of physical artificial intelligence in infrastructure spaces like airports and hospitals to identify potential applications for Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: LiveX Brings Physical AI to Airports, Hospitals and Stores With the Launch of AI City
takeaways: LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo World Congress in Barcelona.
The new platform introduces physical artificial intelligence applications for airports, hospitals, and retail stores.
